AIChatApp Model Reference

- The active offline chat model is configured by LocalModel:FileName in the API configuration.
- The current default local chat model is qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf.
- Chat model files are expected under AIChatApp.Core/Models.
- The API loads the configured GGUF chat model through LLamaSharp at startup.
- Changing the configured model file changes the local chat model without requiring a code edit.
- qwen2.5-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf is the current performance-focused default.
- meta-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf is available as a higher-quality but slower option.

ML.NET reviewer:
- ML.NET is not used to generate chat answers.
- The local GGUF model generates the answer first.
- The ML.NET reviewer classifies generated answer quality after it has been trained and published.
- Training examples come from approved backoffice report reviews with a validated answer and issue category.
- The preferred reviewer-training UI is Backoffice > Machine Learning in AIChatApp.Web.
- Reviewer training UI is now handled by Backoffice > Machine Learning in AIChatApp.Web.
